CustomField.description: Shows freelance interpreter names as plain text, employed interpreter names as links, and other resources as blank. Freelance takes precedence if both flags are true.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(ServiceResource__c), '', IF( ServiceResource__r.HOT_IsFreelanceInterpreter__c, ServiceResource__r.Name, IF( ServiceResource__r.HOT_IsEmployedInterpreter__c, HYPERLINK('/lightning/r/ServiceResource/' + ServiceResource__c + '/view', ServiceResource__r.Name, '_self'), '' ) ) )
CustomField.label: Service Resource Name
